description: Risk R-B, stated before anything else because the class name inverts the behaviour: the prompt-mandated Java class for COTRN01C is TransactionAddController, but this program ADDS NOTHING - it VIEWS. Four independent sources say so: app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:5 'Function    : View a Transaction from TRANSACT file', README.md:223 '| CT01 | COTRN01 | COTRN01C | Transaction View |', app/bms/COTRN01.bms:2 'CardDemo - Transaction View' and app/bms/COTRN01.bms:79 INITIAL='View Transaction'. Rule R1 governs the resolution - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and practice B4 governs the disclosure, so the divergence is documented here and never silently corrected. No arm of this case asserts an insert, expectedWrites is empty on every one of the twenty cases, and the half of the swap that genuinely adds a transaction lives in parity/COTRN02C. WHAT THIS CASE PINS: MAIN-PARA's EIBCALEN = 0 guard at app/cbl/COTRN01C.cbl:94-96. No communication area travelled, so the program cannot know who called it: it moves 'COSGN00C' into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM at :95 and performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN, which transfers at :205-208 without sending a map and without touching TRANSACT once. Because the MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) at :98 is never reached, the area carried forward is this program's own WORKING-STORAGE initial state - blanks for alphanumerics, zeros for PIC 9 items, and 'N' for CDEMO-CT01-NEXT-PAGE-FLG, the one field :57 gives a VALUE clause - with only the three fields :202-204 writes set. EIBAID is never read here, so no AID is declared: declaring one would suggest the key mattered. SEND-TRNVIEW-SCREEN is not performed either, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :243-262 never runs and this case asserts no header field: CURDATEO, CURTIMEO, TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO and PGMNAMEO are values the program does not set on this path, and inventing them would assert behaviour that is not there. The two message channels carry what :91-92 left: MOVE SPACES blanks WS-MESSAGE PIC X(80) and ERRMSGO OF COTRN1AO PIC X(78), so both lines are all spaces at their own declared widths - 80 and 78 - which keeps the 80-to-78 truncation of MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO at :217 visible as two distinct channels rather than one. The three seeded TRANSACT rows stand byte-identical on the final-state channel, which is how the case states that the keyed EXEC CICS READ at :269-275, with the UPDATE option :275 states, is never reached and that nothing was rewritten, trailing CVTRA05Y FILLER PIC X(20) included. BASELINE PROVENANCE (practice B12): every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED, by structured reading of MAIN-PARA and RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy 34+84+12+16+14 = 160 bytes, the CDEMO-CT01-INFO extension at :53-61 16+16+8+1+1+16 = 58 bytes, 218 in all; app/cpy/CVTRA05Y.cpy 350 bytes), the BMS field contract (app/cpy-bms/COTRN01.CPY, 21 xxxI payload items, ERRMSGO PIC X(78)) and the TRANSACT definition in app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, which AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers, and the change of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. GATES DISCHARGED: G15 (one of exactly twenty cases in parity/COTRN01C), G18 (the diff count must be zero, per module rather than per build), G37 (no server-side session state - the whole 218-byte area travels in the request and response payload), G40 (the XCTL at :205-208 resolves to the nextProgram response field, 'COSGN00C' at the X(08) width CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM declares) and G51 (the controller is driven as a plain object, with no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container and no HTTP in the path). Deliberately NOT asserted, because this program has none of them: G32 (zero GO TO), G35 (zero CALL 'CEE3ABD', which is why the return code is 0 and no abend path exists), G39 (no pagination) and G43 (no 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC).
